correctness.rationale: The independent Poisson common-clock parity law gives an exact two-product mixture for all finite n and t. Walsh orthogonality yields exact chi-square; n-dependent binomial Gaussian convergence plus uniform L2 boundedness proves the full TV and chi-square window limits. Gaussian paired-density positivity proves strict intensity ordering; L1 Taylor expansions establish the two late-window powers; convexity and antipodal symmetrization give uniform two-sided cutoff bounds. 4,533 finite checks support but do not prove infinite claims.

value.rationale: The independently motivated rare common-flip perturbation produces a full strict one-parameter family of cutoff profiles at the natural sharp rate scale 1/(n log n), with an exact chi-square crossover and a genuine change in the late-window exponent. This distinguishes changes in long-range update mechanism that cannot be inferred from the ordinary Gaussian cutoff alone; it is a structural probability theorem, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
